profile.method: Published operator range with wider braking entries and tighter apexes registered to retained mapped corners. Local widths are reconstruction estimates, not a white-line survey. Existing smooth cubic transitions join the controls.
profile.edge_definition: Racecourse between white edges or kerbs, excluding painted runoff, pit lane and blue/red escape aprons.
